rows.note: Use 吸收 as the all-purpose verb for taking nutrients into the body or taking in information.

example.english: After reading the book, I need time to assimilate the new knowledge.
example.traditional: 我睇完本書，要慢慢吸收啲新知識。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 jyun4 bun2 syu1 jiu3 maan6 maan6 kap1 sau1 di1 san1 zi1 sik1

rows.note: Use this everyday construction when a person or group is being integrated into a community or culture.

example.english: We should assimilate new immigrants into the community so they can adapt more quickly.
example.traditional: 我哋應該將新移民融入社區，等佢哋快啲適應。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 zoeng1 san1 ji4 man4 jung4 jap6 se5 keoi1 dang2 keoi5 dei6 faai3 di1 sik1 jing3

rows.note: Use 同化 for the more exact or deliberate idea of making a person or group adopt the characteristics of another culture.

example.english: The colonial government attempted to assimilate the local people through its education system.
example.traditional: 殖民政府企圖用教育制度同化當地人。
example.jyutping: zik6 man4 zing3 fu2 kei5 tou4 jung6 gaau3 juk6 zai3 dou6 tung4 faa3 dong1 dei6 jan4
